ticketPayload.title: Cisco AnyConnect Connection Timeouts
ticketPayload.description: Incoming tickets reporting 'Gateway Unreachable' or connection hangs at 86% when attempting to authenticate to Cisco AnyConnect VPN profile.

missionPayload.title: Restore Remote Gateways
missionPayload.objective: Isolate the Cisco AnyConnect failure, clear connection queues, and confirm gateway connectivity.

ticketPayload.title: CRITICAL: AD login failed / Locked out
ticketPayload.description: Active Directory service is throwing error LSASS.exe terminated unexpectedly. Employees unable to authenticate, map network drives, or login to local endpoints.

missionPayload.title: Defend the Realm (AD)
missionPayload.objective: Access Domain Controller TSM-DC-01, resolve the crashed Active Directory service, and verify domain authentication is functional.

scenarios.title: VMware CRM Host Memory Allocation Failure

ticketPayload.title: CRM Database Connection Error: IIS 503 Service Unavailable
ticketPayload.description: Sales reps report CRM-PROD-01 VM completely dead. Internal web portal showing 503 errors and MS-SQL cluster handshake failure.

missionPayload.title: Revive CRM Host
missionPayload.objective: Query VMware ESXi-01, allocate correct memory reserves, start the virtual machine, and verify SQL services.

ticketPayload.title: Dell Latitude 7450 - Laptop no longer powers on
Distribution Switch Offline - Unable to access ERP

aiAssessment.recommendation: Escalate to NetOps / Dispatch Field Tech

ticketPayload.title: Sarah Johnson - Account Locked (18 failed login attempts)

aiAssessment.recommendation: Unlock Account, Reset Password, Require MFA Re-registration

scenarios.title: HQ Sales Department Printer Queue Lock

ticketPayload.title: HQ Sales Copier - Stuck Print Jobs
ticketPayload.description: The printer is completely unresponsive. Printing queue contains 18 stale print jobs. Attempting to clear locally fails. Status LED blinking red.

missionPayload.title: Clear the Print Spooler Jam
missionPayload.objective: Isolate TSM-PRNT-01, flush stalled print queues on server, and execute hardware service reset.
